title: Implementation, needs coverage, and effectiveness of outpatient versus inpatient work-related medical rehabilitation in cardiac, neurological, oncological, and psychosomatic rehabilitation - survey of rehabilitation facilities authorized for work-related medical rehabilitation
summary: A primary goal of medical rehabilitation on behalf of the German Pension Insurance (DRV) is to promote work participation. Therefore, the work-related medical rehabilitation (WMR) was introduced approximately 15 years ago and has since become established nationwide. The study examines the implementation of WMR services, differentiating between cardiological, neurological, oncological, and psychosomatic indications, as well as between outpatient and inpatient rehabilitation settings.

interventions.name: Institutions of work-related medical rehabilitation (WMR) are being surveyed regarding the implementation of WMR measures.
